subject: Halo Health — AZ2 throughput & error spike / regional drain plan
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@halohealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, sre@halohealth.com
Cc: rajiv.menon@halohealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production: AZ2 throughput & 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Hi Mateo / Redwood team,

We're seeing a sustained throughput spike in AZ2 beginning ~07:40 PT with elevated 5xx rates (~8-12%) and token-level latency doubling for our inference route. This started during our morning batch run but is now impacting live traffic. Error traces point to prefill timeouts and frequent model fallback attempts.

Can you confirm whether there's a routing change or capacity event on your side? We need an immediate plan to drain traffic away from AZ2 to avoid customer-facing errors. We're on call and can escalate internally on our end if helpful.

Attaching a short traffic snapshot and a CPU/gpu utilization screenshot.

Thanks,
Claire Hsu
Head of Platform Reliability
Halo Health

Attachments: traffic_snapshot.json (log excerpt), halo_cpu_profile.png (screenshot)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@halohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: AZ2 throughput & 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Claire — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I pulled infra metrics and I can confirm there was an autoscaler churn event in us-west-2 (AZ2) at 07:35 PT; some nodes reported elevated kernel stalls and we saw a transient mesh routing policy flip that briefly preferred a different qps bucket for a subset of customers. We're investigating root cause.

Immediate proposed steps (I need your go/no-go):
- Activate cross-region drain for Halo Health to prefer us-west-1 and us-east-1 for 90 minutes (no code change required).
- Push a temporary routing policy to keep prefabricated KV caches pinned to warm hosts for Halo to reduce prefill work.
- If drain does not stabilize within 20 minutes, fail traffic over fully to us-east-1 and enable reduced-batch mode for latency-critical routes.

Rishi / Olga — can you join the call? We may need a canary config push and an exec alert if this requires a sustained failover.

Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

Onboarding note: I'm looping in Rishi and Olga for routing/failover ops.
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: AZ2 throughput & 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Taking point for the ops side. Summary of observations so far:
- Autoscaler churn at 07:35 PT caused ephemeral pod restarts; several GPU hosts reported OOMs due to a mis-sized batch path in the new kernel optimization.
- Mesh routing flipped a subset of Halo's sessions to a lower-priority queue for ~6 minutes.
- KV cache warmers failed to reconcile after node restarts, causing heavier prefill load.

Action items I'll execute now:
1) Start a targeted cross-region drain for Halo (AZ2 -> us-west-1/us-east-1) with gradual 30% step every 4 minutes.
2) Apply a temporary kernel-mode roll-back for the affected instance class to eliminate the mis-sized batch path for the next 2 hours.
3) Enable prefix caching pin for Halo routes to reduce cold-prefill.

If this needs exec attention (30+ minutes with errors not decreasing), request a Level 2 exec bridge.

I will post a short plan document to Drive (INF-4217) and notify Claire when drain starts.

— Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@halohealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@halohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:52:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: AZ2 throughput & 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Claire / Rajiv — we are initiating a gradual cross-region drain for Halo at 08:52 PT. Plan summary:
- Phase 1 (08:52–09:12 PT): 30% traffic shift to us-west-1 and 30% to us-east-1, keep 40% in AZ2 for warm cache reconciliation.
- Metrics watch: 5xx rate, median and p95 latency, and prefill time. We will share live metrics every 5 minutes in the Drive doc.
- If 5xx remains >3% after two phases, we will complete full evacuation to us-east-1 and enable reduced-batch mode.

Expected customer impact: small routing jitter for a short period (retries may cause duplicated requests at the application layer). Recommend pausing non-critical batch jobs until stabilization.

I'll post updates here and in the Drive doc (INF-4217). Thank you for your patience — we will prioritize stabilization over feature throughput.

Attachments: redwood_action_plan_v1.pdf

Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@halohealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, rajiv.menon@halohealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: AZ2 throughput & 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Mateo / Rishi / Olga — quick update from Halo: after the partial drain and the temporary kernel rollback you applied, error rates dropped to <1% and latency returned to baseline during peak. We kept reduced batch mode enabled for the rest of the day and resumed full batch jobs overnight.

Two follow-ups from our side:
- Can we schedule a post-incident RCA with your infra and kernel leads next week? Prefer Tue/Thu afternoon PT.
- We would like a documented mitigation playbook for Halo that includes the exact routing steps, expected impact, and a rollback checklist.

Thank you for the rapid response. If you need any logs from our side for the RCA, let us know.

Best,
Claire
Head of Platform Reliability, Halo Health
